ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountDetailApplication } from '../templates/details/Application.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountDetailApplication(element, i18n, onError);
	result.app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	await result.router.isReady();
	return () => result.app.unmount();
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { inject } from 'vue';
import { RouterLink, RouterView } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useApplication } from './Pages.js';
import { syntheticStateKey } from './Application.js';
import { createSyntheticServices } from './Service.js';
import { markRaw } from 'vue';
import { gate } from './Protocol.js';
const app = useApplication();
const techTheme = { colorMode: 'dark' } as const;
const faults = inject(syntheticStateKey)!;
const families = [
	{
		id: 'minimal',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.details.minimalStyle');
		}
	},
	{
		id: 'brand',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.details.brandStyle');
		}
	},
	{
		id: 'tech',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.details.techStyle');
		}
	}
];
const sizes: readonly AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
function guardLink(event: MouseEvent, navigate: (event: MouseEvent) => unknown) {
	if (!gate(app, 'switch-family')) event.preventDefault();
	else void navigate(event);
}
function changeIdentity() {
	app.access.identity = app.access.identity === 'reader-a' ? 'reader-b' : 'reader-a';
}
function changeScope() {
	app.access.scope = app.access.scope === 'synthetic-east' ? 'synthetic-west' : 'synthetic-east';
	app.runtime.setScope(app.access.scope);
}
function replaceServices() {
	app.services = markRaw(createSyntheticServices(faults));
}

function updateAppSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		app.size = value;
}

function updateFaultsMode(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'empty' || value === 'missing' || value === 'forbidden')
		faults.mode = value;
}
</script>

ts
import { createApp, markRaw, reactive, shallowReactive } from 'vue';
import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHashHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { getAsamDataRuntime, provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { detailApplicationKey } from './Types.js';
import type { DetailApplication } from './Types.js';
import { createSyntheticServices } from './Service.js';
import type { SyntheticState } from './Service.js';
import App from './App.vue';
import MinimalList from './minimal/ListPage.vue';
import MinimalDetail from './minimal/DetailPage.vue';
import MinimalFlow from './minimal/FlowPage.vue';
import BrandList from './brand/ListPage.vue';
import BrandDetail from './brand/DetailPage.vue';
import BrandFlow from './brand/FlowPage.vue';
import TechList from './tech/ListPage.vue';
import TechDetail from './tech/DetailPage.vue';
import TechFlow from './tech/FlowPage.vue';
export const syntheticStateKey: InjectionKey<SyntheticState> = Symbol('synthetic state');
export function mountDetailApplication(
	element: string | Element,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const app = createApp(App);
	if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	const faults = reactive<SyntheticState>({
		failList: false,
		failDetail: false,
		failFlow: false,
		failDictionary: false,
		failResource: false,
		mode: 'normal',
		count: 100
	});
	const audit: {
		endpoint: string;
		requestId: number;
		identity: { identity: string; scope: string; revision: number };
	}[] = [];
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHashHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', redirect: '/minimal/list' },
			...(
				[
					['minimal', MinimalList, MinimalDetail, MinimalFlow],
					['brand', BrandList, BrandDetail, BrandFlow],
					['tech', TechList, TechDetail, TechFlow]
				] as const
			).flatMap(([family, list, detail, flow]) => [
				{ path: `/${family}/list`, component: list },
				{ path: `/${family}/detail/:type/:id`, component: detail },
				{ path: `/${family}/flow/:type/:id`, component: flow }
			]),
			{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', redirect: '/minimal/list' }
		]
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'synthetic-east' });
	const context = shallowReactive<DetailApplication>({
		runtime: markRaw(getAsamDataRuntime(app)),
		router: markRaw(router),
		access: reactive({
			identity: 'reader-a',
			scope: 'synthetic-east',
			revision: 1,
			disabled: false,
			readonly: false,
			allowed: true
		}),
		services: markRaw(createSyntheticServices(faults, audit)),
		returnState: null,
		size: 'default',
		dark: matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
	});
	app.provide(detailApplicationKey, context);
	app.provide(syntheticStateKey, faults);
	app.use(router);
	((app.config.errorHandler = onError), app.mount(element));
	return { app, context, faults, audit, router };
}
ts
import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamFieldModes,
	createAsamNumberField,
	createAsamTemporalField,
	createAsamResourceField,
	createAsamResourceDisplayReader
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldViewBinding } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { DetailApplication } from './Types.js';
import { gate, identity } from './Protocol.js';

export const templateConfig = {
	pageSize: 20 as const,
	groups: ['事项摘要', '责任与安排', '资料与备注'] as const
};
export const initialQuery = () => ({
	text: '',
	state: null,
	dates: { start: null, end: null },
	owner: ''
});
export function createPageFields(app: DetailApplication) {
	const source = defineAsamOptions<
		string | number,
		{ value: string | number; label: string }
	>().api({
		api: async (_params: object, context) => {
			if (!gate(app, 'dictionary-read') || !app.runtime.isCurrent(context))
				throw Error('字典读取门禁已变更');
			return app.services.dictionary(context, identity(app));
		},
		params: {},
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { value: 'value', label: 'label' }
	});
	const query: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
		{ key: 'text', label: '事项名称', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'state', label: '状态', kind: 'single', source },
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'dates',
			label: '登记日期区间',
			kind: 'date',
			range: true,
			allowOpen: true
		}),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', kind: 'text' }
	];
	const groups = templateConfig.groups;
	const grouping = (group: string) => ({ detail: { layout: { group } } });
	const fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
		{ key: 'title', label: '事项名称', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[0]) },
		{
			key: 'identifier',
			label: '稳定标识（类型:值）',
			kind: 'text',
			modes: grouping(groups[0])
		},
		{ key: 'state', label: '状态', kind: 'single', source, modes: grouping(groups[0]) },
		createAsamNumberField({
			key: 'quantity',
			label: '待核对数量',
			integer: true,
			min: 0,
			modes: grouping(groups[0])
		}),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[1]) },
		{ key: 'organization', label: '组织', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[1]) },
		{ key: 'priority', label: '优先级', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[1]) },
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'due',
			label: '计划日期',
			kind: 'date',
			modes: grouping(groups[1])
		}),
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'created',
			label: '登记日期',
			kind: 'date',
			modes: grouping(groups[2])
		}),
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'updated',
			label: '更新日期',
			kind: 'date',
			modes: grouping(groups[2])
		}),
		createAsamResourceField({
			key: 'resource',
			label: '关联附件',
			modes: grouping(groups[2]),
			services: {
				upload: async () => {
					throw Error('本模板不提供上传');
				}
			}
		}),
		{ key: 'note', label: '备注', kind: 'textarea', modes: grouping(groups[2]) }
	];
	const bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[] = fields.map((field) => ({
		field,
		...(field.key === 'resource'
			? {
					reader: createAsamResourceDisplayReader(async (ids, signal) => {
						if (!gate(app, 'resource-read')) throw Error('附件读取门禁已变更');
						return app.services.resolve(ids, signal);
					})
				}
			: {})
	}));
	const modes = createAsamFieldModes({ bindings });
	return { query, fields: modes.fields, bindings: modes.bindings, modes };
}

	<div v-if="data" class="field-groups">
		<section v-for="group in groups" :key="group" :aria-label="group">
			<h3>{{ group }}</h3>
			<dl>
				<div
					v-for="binding in bindings.filter(
						(item) => item.field.modes?.detail?.layout?.group === group
					)"
					:key="binding.field.key"
					class="field-value"
				>
					<dt>{{ binding.field.label }}</dt>
					<dd>
						<AsamFieldView
							:binding="binding"
							:model-value="data[binding.field.key]"
							context="detail"
							:session="session"
							:active="active"
							:size="size"
							readonly
						/>
					</dd>
				</div>
			</dl>
		</section>
	</div>
</template>

import type { AsamFieldModel, AsamFieldViewBinding } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

defineProps<{
	data?: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>;
	bindings: readonly AsamFieldViewBinding[];
	groups: readonly string[];
	session: number;
	active: boolean;
	size: AsamControlSize;
}>();
</script>

			>
				<h3>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.details.currentStage') }} {{ data.stage }}</h3>

				<ol class="flow-steps">

						<span>{{ step.name }}</span

							stepLabels[step.state] ?? i18n.t('app.templates.details.unknownState')
						}}</strong>
					</li>
				</ol>
			</section>
			<section
				v-show="tab === 'history'"
				:id="`${uid}-history`"
				role="tabpanel"
				:aria-labelledby="`${uid}-history-tab`"
				tabindex="0"

				<h3>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.details.flowHistory') }}</h3>
				<p>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.details.recordsRetainServiceOrderTimesAreUtc') }}</p>
				<ol class="flow-records">
					<li v-for="record in data.records" :key="record.id" :data-record="record.id">
						<div>
							<strong>{{ record.actor }}</strong
							><time v-if="record.at" :datetime="record.at">{{
								record.at.replace('T', ' ').replace('Z', ' UTC')

							><span v-else>{{
								i18n.t('app.templates.details.timeNotSupplied')
							}}</span>
						</div>
						<p>{{ record.result }}</p>
						<small>{{
							record.state === 'recorded'
								? i18n.t('app.templates.details.recorded')
								: i18n.t('app.templates.details.unknownStateValue', {
										value: record.state
									})
						}}</small>
					</li>
				</ol>
			</section>
			<section
				v-show="tab === 'related'"
				:id="`${uid}-related`"
				role="tabpanel"
				:aria-labelledby="`${uid}-related-tab`"
				tabindex="0"
			>
				<h3>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.details.relatedInformation') }}</h3>
				<ul class="related-items">
					<li v-for="item in data.related" :key="item.id">
						<strong>{{ item.title }}</strong>
						<p>{{ item.note }}</p>
					</li>
				</ul>
			</section></template
		>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import { computed, useId } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { FlowData, FlowTab } from './Types.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	data?: FlowData;
	loading: boolean;
	error: string;
	tab: FlowTab;
	disabled: boolean;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [tab: string]; retry: [] }>();
const uid = useId();
function tabAttributes(
	id: string
): Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'id' | 'role' | 'aria-selected' | 'aria-controls' | 'tabindex'> {
	return {
		id: `${uid}-${id}-tab`,
		role: 'tab',
		'aria-selected': props.tab === id,
		'aria-controls': `${uid}-${id}`,
		tabindex: props.tab === id ? 0 : -1
	};
}
const tabs = computed(() => [
	{ id: 'overview', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.overview') },
	{ id: 'history', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.flowHistory') },
	{ id: 'related', label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.relatedInformation') }
]);
const stepLabels = computed(() => ({
	done: i18n.t('app.templates.details.complete'),
	current: i18n.t('app.templates.details.inProgress'),
	waiting: i18n.t('app.templates.details.waitingToStart'),
	unknown: i18n.t('app.templates.details.unknownState')
}));
function keyboard(event: KeyboardEvent) {
	if (props.disabled || !['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
	event.preventDefault();
	const index = tabs.value.findIndex((item) => item.id === props.tab);
	const next =
		event.key === 'Home'
			? 0
			: event.key === 'End'
				? 2
				: (index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : 2)) % 3;
	const value = tabs.value[next]!.id;
	emit('select', value);
	if (props.tab === value) document.getElementById(`${uid}-${value}-tab`)?.focus();
	else
		queueMicrotask(() => {
			if (props.tab === value && !props.disabled)
				document.getElementById(`${uid}-${value}-tab`)?.focus();
		});
}
</script>

import { formatFieldError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, effectScope, inject, nextTick, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { EffectScope } from 'vue';
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router';
import { useAsamDetail, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useAsamReadonlyCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type {
	AsamColumnPreferenceDocument,
	AsamDetailController,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest,
	AsamOperationColumn
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamReadonlyCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamRequestContext } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { detailApplicationKey } from './Types.js';
export { detailApplicationKey } from './Types.js';
import type { DetailApplication, Family, FlowData, FlowTab, RecordRow } from './Types.js';
import { createPageFields, initialQuery, templateConfig } from './Config.js';
import {
	gate,
	idKey,
	identity,
	listTarget,
	parseId,
	readable,
	remember,
	restore,
	safeReturn
} from './Protocol.js';

export function useApplication(): DetailApplication {
	const app = inject(detailApplicationKey);
	if (!app) throw Error('请先提供 DetailApplication');
	return app;
}
const message = (cause: unknown) => (cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause));
export function usePage(family: Family) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const app = useApplication(),
		route = useRoute(),
		epoch = shallowRef(app.runtime.epoch);
	onScopeDispose(
		app.runtime.onInvalidate(() => {
			epoch.value = app.runtime.epoch;
		})
	);
	const signature = [
		() => app.access.identity,
		() => app.access.scope,
		() => app.access.revision,
		() => app.services,
		() => app.access.allowed,
		() => app.access.disabled,
		() => epoch.value
	] as const;
	const reason = computed(() =>
		app.access.disabled
			? i18n.t('app.templates.details.thisPageIsDisabledReadingAndNavigationArePaused')
			: !app.access.allowed
				? i18n.t('app.templates.details.theCurrentIdentityDoesNotHaveReadAccess')
				: app.access.readonly
					? i18n.t('app.templates.details.readOnlyModeSearchViewAndReturnNoBusiness')
					: i18n.t('app.templates.details.syntheticDataDemoWithReadingAndNavigationOnly')
	);
	async function back() {
		const path = route.fullPath;
		if (gate(app, 'return-list') && route.fullPath === path)
			await app.router.push(safeReturn(route.query.returnTo, family));
	}
	return { app, route, signature, reason, back, i18n };
}
export function useListPage(family: Family, borrowed?: AsamListController<RecordRow>) {
	const common = usePage(family),
		{ app, signature } = common;
	const controller = shallowRef<AsamListController<RecordRow>>(),
		crud = shallowRef<AsamReadonlyCrudController<RecordRow, string>>(),
		session = shallowRef(0);
	let owned: EffectScope | undefined;
	const columns: readonly AsamOperationColumn<RecordRow>[] = [
		{ key: 'title', label: '事项', sortable: true, width: 230 },
		{ key: 'id', label: '标识', width: 150 },
		{ key: 'state', label: '状态', width: 130 },
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', width: 150 },
		{ key: 'organization', label: '组织', width: 220 },
		{ key: 'created', label: '登记日期', sortable: true, width: 150 }
	];
	const stateBinding = shallowRef(
		createPageFields(app).bindings.find((binding) => binding.field.key === 'state')!
	);
	watch(
		signature,
		() => {
			const token = ++session.value;
			owned?.stop();
			owned = undefined;
			crud.value = undefined;
			controller.value = undefined;
			if (!readable(app)) return;
			// 借入控制器只绑定本次明确会话；边界变化后由宿主新key重建绑定，不操作旧资源。
			if (borrowed && token > 1) return;
			const fields = createPageFields(app);
			stateBinding.value = fields.bindings.find((binding) => binding.field.key === 'state')!;
			owned = effectScope();
			owned.run(() => {
				const readList = async (request: AsamListRequest, context: AsamRequestContext) => {
					if (
						token !== session.value ||
						!gate(app, 'list-read') ||
						!app.runtime.isCurrent(context)
					)
						throw Error('列表读取会话已失效');
					return app.services.list(request, context, identity(app));
				};
				const list =
					borrowed ??
					useAsamListController<RecordRow>({
						fields: fields.query,
						initial: initialQuery(),
						rowKey: (row) => idKey(row.id),
						runtime: app.runtime,
						immediate: false,
						pageSize: templateConfig.pageSize,
						api: readList
					});
				let preference: AsamColumnPreferenceDocument | undefined;
				crud.value = useAsamReadonlyCrudController<RecordRow, AsamFieldModel, string>({
					mode: 'readonly',
					list,
					runtime: app.runtime,
					rowKey: (row) => idKey(row.id),
					isKey: (value): value is string => typeof value === 'string',
					dataset: listTarget(family),
					initial: initialQuery(),
					queryFields: fields.query,
					queryCodec: {
						encode: (query) => ({ ...query }),
						decode: (query) => ({ ...query })
					},
					columns,
					detailFields: fields.fields,
					detail: {
						mode: 'load',
						load: async (key, context) => {
							const row = list.page.data.value.list.find(
								(item) => idKey(item.id) === key
							);
							if (!row) return { status: 'missing' };
							if (
								token !== session.value ||
								!gate(app, 'detail-read') ||
								!app.runtime.isCurrent(context)
							)
								return { status: 'forbidden' };
							return app.services.detail(row.id, context, identity(app));
						}
					},
					preferences: {
						scope: {
							application: 'details-template',
							principal: app.access.identity,
							table: family,
							version: '1'
						},
						adapter: {
							load: async () => preference,
							save: async (_, value) => {
								preference = value;
							},
							reset: async () => {
								preference = undefined;
							}
						}
					},
					services: { list: readList },
					disabled: () => !readable(app)
				});
				controller.value = list;
			});
			void nextTick(async () => {
				if (token === session.value && controller.value && readable(app))
					await restore(app, controller.value, listTarget(family));
			});
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		++session.value;
		owned?.stop();
	});
	async function open(row: RecordRow, kind: 'detail' | 'flow', source = controller.value) {
		const current = controller.value;
		const path = common.route.fullPath;
		if (!current || current !== source || !current.resultReady.value) return;
		// CRUD 行操作交付不可变快照，导航前用保留类型的 ID 查回本页行。
		const target = current.page.data.value.list.find(
			(item) => idKey(item.id) === idKey(row.id)
		);
		if (!target || !gate(app, `open-${kind}`)) return;
		if (
			current !== controller.value ||
			common.route.fullPath !== path ||
			!current.page.data.value.list.includes(target) ||
			!remember(app, current, family)
		)
			return;
		await app.router.push({
			path: `/${family}/${kind}/${typeof target.id}/${encodeURIComponent(String(target.id))}`,
			query: { returnTo: listTarget(family) }
		});
	}
	return { ...common, controller, crud, session, columns, stateBinding, open, templateConfig };
}
export function useDetailPage(family: Family, flow = false, borrowed?: AsamDetailController) {
	const common = usePage(family),
		{ app, route, signature, i18n } = common;
	const fields = createPageFields(app),
		borrowedInvalid = shallowRef(false);
	const sourceController =
		borrowed ?? useAsamDetail({ fields: fields.fields, runtime: app.runtime });
	const controller: AsamDetailController = borrowed
		? {
				...borrowed,
				data: computed(() => (borrowedInvalid.value ? undefined : borrowed.data.value)),
				status: computed(() => (borrowedInvalid.value ? 'idle' : borrowed.status.value)),
				message: computed(() =>
					borrowedInvalid.value
						? '等待宿主为当前目标重新绑定详情会话'
						: borrowed.message.value
				),
				formatMessage: (scope) =>
					borrowedInvalid.value
						? scope.t('app.templates.details.waitingForTheHostToBindADetailSession')
						: (borrowed.formatMessage?.(scope) ?? borrowed.message.value),
				active: computed(() => !borrowedInvalid.value && borrowed.active.value),
				canRefresh: computed(() => !borrowedInvalid.value && borrowed.canRefresh.value),
				refresh: async () => {
					if (!borrowedInvalid.value) await borrowed.refresh();
				},
				close: () => {},
				dispose: () => {}
			}
		: sourceController;
	const invalidIdSource = shallowRef<unknown>();
	const flowData = shallowRef<FlowData>(),
		flowError = shallowRef(''),
		flowLoading = shallowRef(false),
		tab = shallowRef<FlowTab>('overview'),
		invalidId = shallowRef(''),
		session = shallowRef(0);
	let flowContext: AsamRequestContext | undefined;
	function cancelFlow() {
		if (flowContext) app.runtime.release(flowContext);
		flowContext = undefined;
		flowData.value = undefined;
		flowError.value = '';
		flowLoading.value = false;
	}
	function target() {
		return parseId(route.params.type, route.params.id);
	}
	async function readFlow() {
		const token = session.value;
		if (!flow || flowLoading.value || !gate(app, 'flow-read') || token !== session.value)
			return;
		const services = app.services,
			context = app.runtime.createContext();
		flowContext = context;
		flowLoading.value = true;
		flowError.value = '';
		flowData.value = undefined;
		const current = () =>
			token === session.value &&
			services === app.services &&
			readable(app) &&
			app.runtime.isCurrent(context);
		try {
			const result = await services.flow(target(), context, identity(app));
			if (current()) flowData.value = result;
		} catch (cause) {
			if (current()) flowError.value = message(cause);
		} finally {
			app.runtime.release(context);
			if (flowContext === context) {
				flowContext = undefined;
				flowLoading.value = false;
			}
		}
	}
	watch(
		[...signature, () => route.params.type, () => route.params.id],
		() => {
			const token = ++session.value;
			if (borrowed && token > 1) borrowedInvalid.value = true;
			cancelFlow();
			tab.value = 'overview';
			invalidId.value = '';
			invalidIdSource.value = undefined;
			if (!borrowed) controller.close();
			if (!readable(app) || borrowedInvalid.value) return;
			let id;
			try {
				id = target();
			} catch (cause) {
				invalidId.value = message(cause);
				invalidIdSource.value = cause;
				return;
			}
			void nextTick(async () => {
				if (token !== session.value || !gate(app, 'detail-open') || token !== session.value)
					return;
				if (!borrowed)
					await controller.open({
						mode: 'load',
						id,
						load: async (recordId, context) => {
							if (
								token !== session.value ||
								!gate(app, 'detail-read') ||
								!app.runtime.isCurrent(context)
							)
								throw Error('详情读取会话已失效');
							const result = await app.services.detail(
								recordId,
								context,
								identity(app)
							);
							if (result.status !== 'ready') return result;
							const initialized = fields.modes.initializeResult(result.data, 'edit');
							if (initialized.status === 'error')
								throw Error(
									initialized.issues.map((issue) => issue.message).join('；')
								);
							return { status: 'ready', data: initialized.data };
						}
					});
				if (token === session.value && readable(app) && controller.status.value === 'ready')
					await readFlow();
			});
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	async function refresh() {
		if (!gate(app, 'detail-refresh')) return;
		const token = session.value;
		await controller.refresh();
		if (flow && token === session.value && readable(app) && controller.status.value === 'ready')
			await readFlow();
	}
	const panel: AsamDetailController = {
		...controller,
		fields: [],
		close: borrowed ? () => {} : controller.close,
		canRefresh: computed(() => readable(app) && controller.canRefresh.value),
		refresh
	};
	function selectTab(value: string) {
		const token = session.value;
		if (gate(app, 'select-tab') && token === session.value)
			tab.value = ['overview', 'history', 'related'].includes(value)
				? (value as FlowTab)
				: 'overview';
	}
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		++session.value;
		cancelFlow();
		if (!borrowed) controller.dispose();
	});
	return {
		...common,
		controller,
		panel,
		bindings: fields.bindings,
		groups: templateConfig.groups,
		flowData,
		flowError,
		flowLoading,
		tab,
		selectTab,
		readFlow,
		refresh,
		invalidId: computed(() =>
			invalidIdSource.value ? formatFieldError(invalidIdSource.value, i18n) : invalidId.value
		),
		session,
		templateConfig
	};
}
ts
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { cloneAsamFieldValue } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListController, AsamListIntent, AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { DetailApplication, Family, RecordId, RecordRow, ReadIdentity } from './Types.js';

export const families: readonly Family[] = ['minimal', 'brand', 'tech'];
export function parseId(type: unknown, value: unknown): RecordId {
	if (
		type === 'number' &&
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		value.trim() !== '' &&
		Number.isFinite(Number(value))
	)
		return Number(value);
	if (type === 'string' && typeof value === 'string' && value !== '') return value;
	throw createAsamMessageError(
		new TypeError('记录 ID 必须是非空字符串或有限数字；拒绝 boolean/null'),
		'app.templates.details.recordIdMustBeANonemptyStringOrFinite'
	);
}
export function idKey(id: RecordId): string {
	if (!((typeof id === 'string' && id !== '') || (typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id))))
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('无效记录 ID'),
			'app.templates.details.invalidRecordId'
		);
	return `${typeof id}:${id}`;
}
export function listTarget(family: Family): string {
	return `/${family}/list`;
}
export function safeReturn(value: unknown, family: Family): string {
	return typeof value === 'string' && families.some((item) => value === listTarget(item))
		? value
		: listTarget(family);
}
export function identity(app: DetailApplication): ReadIdentity {
	return {
		identity: app.access.identity,
		scope: app.access.scope,
		revision: app.access.revision
	};
}
export function readable(app: DetailApplication): boolean {
	return app.access.allowed && !app.access.disabled && app.runtime.scope === app.access.scope;
}
export function gate(app: DetailApplication, action: string): boolean {
	if (!readable(app)) return false;
	const snapshot = identity(app),
		epoch = app.runtime.epoch,
		services = app.services;
	app.beforeAction?.(action);
	return (
		readable(app) &&
		services === app.services &&
		epoch === app.runtime.epoch &&
		snapshot.identity === app.access.identity &&
		snapshot.scope === app.access.scope &&
		snapshot.revision === app.access.revision
	);
}
export function remember(
	app: DetailApplication,
	controller: AsamListController<RecordRow>,
	family: Family
): boolean {
	const intent = controller.successfulSource.value;
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !intent || !readable(app)) return false;
	app.returnState = {
		...identity(app),
		epoch: app.runtime.epoch,
		services: app.services,
		target: listTarget(family),
		intent: cloneAsamFieldValue(intent) as AsamListIntent
	};
	return true;
}
export function validReturn(app: DetailApplication, target: string): boolean {
	const saved = app.returnState;
	return (
		!!saved &&
		saved.target === target &&
		saved.services === app.services &&
		saved.epoch === app.runtime.epoch &&
		saved.identity === app.access.identity &&
		saved.scope === app.access.scope &&
		saved.revision === app.access.revision
	);
}
export async function restore(
	app: DetailApplication,
	controller: AsamListController<RecordRow>,
	target: string
): Promise<void> {
	if (!gate(app, 'restore-list')) return;
	const saved = validReturn(app, target) ? app.returnState : null;
	if (!saved) {
		await controller.submit();
		return;
	}
	const current = () =>
		readable(app) &&
		app.returnState === saved &&
		validReturn(app, target) &&
		!controller.dirty.value;
	if (
		(
			await controller.replaceConditions(
				cloneAsamFieldValue(saved.intent.query) as AsamFieldModel,
				{ mode: 'submit', force: true }
			)
		).status !== 'success'
	)
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	if (
		controller.intent.value?.pageSize !== saved.intent.pageSize &&
		(await controller.setPageSize(saved.intent.pageSize)).status !== 'success'
	)
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	if (saved.intent.sort && (await controller.setSort(saved.intent.sort)).status !== 'success')
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	const last = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(controller.page.data.value.total / saved.intent.pageSize));
	await controller.setPage(Math.min(saved.intent.currentPage, last));
}
vue
<template>
	<p
		v-if="app.access.disabled || !app.access.allowed || app.access.readonly"
		class="access-reason"
		role="status"
	>
		{{ reason }}
	</p>
	<AsamCrudPage
		v-if="crud"
		:key="session"
		class="records-list"
		:controller="crud"
		presentation="query-table"
		:title="i18n.t('app.templates.details.recordSearch')"
		:show-heading="false"
		:detail-entry="false"
		:detail-on-row-dblclick="false"
		:page-padding="20"
		:action-column-width="240"
		:action-column-fixed="false"
		:row-action-overflow="false"
		:row-action-size="app.size"
		:size="app.size"
		:row-actions="rowActions"
		><template #toolbar
			><div class="results-heading">
				<h2>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.details.searchResults') }}</h2>
				<p>
					{{
						crud.list.dirty.value
							? i18n.t('app.templates.details.thereIsAnUnsubmittedQueryDraftResults')
							: i18n.t(
									'app.templates.details.resultsMatchTheCurrentlySubmittedConditions'
								)
					}}
				</p>
			</div></template
		><template #cell="{ row, column }"
			><AsamFieldView
				v-if="column.key === 'state'"
				:binding="stateBinding"
				:model-value="row.state"
				context="list"
				:session="session"
				:size="app.size"
			/><span v-else-if="column.key === 'id'">{{ idKey(row.id) }}</span
			><span v-else>{{ row[column.key] }}</span></template
		></AsamCrudPage
	>
	<footer class="page-note">
		{{ i18n.t('app.templates.details.returnStateIsStoredOnlyInApplication') }}
	</footer>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamCrudPage } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import { AsamFieldView } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useListPage } from './Pages.js';
import { idKey } from './Protocol.js';
import type { Family, RecordRow } from './Types.js';

const props = defineProps<{ family: Family }>();
const { app, crud, session, stateBinding, reason, open, i18n } = useListPage(props.family);
const rowActions = computed<readonly AsamListAction<RecordRow>[]>(() => {
	const list = crud.value?.list;
	return [
		{
			id: 'basic-details',
			label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.basicDetails'),
			run: async ({ row }) => {
				if (row && list) await open(row, 'detail', list);
			}
		},
		{
			id: 'flow-details',
			label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.flowDetails'),
			run: async ({ row }) => {
				if (row && list) await open(row, 'flow', list);
			}
		}
	];
});
</script>
<style scoped>
.results-heading h2,
.results-heading p {
	margin: 0;
}
.results-heading p {
	font-size: 13px;
}
</style>
ts
import type { AsamFieldModel, AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamRequestContext } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DetailServices, RecordId, RecordRow, ReadIdentity } from './Types.js';
import { idKey } from './Protocol.js';

export interface SyntheticState {
	failList: boolean;
	failDetail: boolean;
	failFlow: boolean;
	failDictionary: boolean;
	failResource: boolean;
	mode: 'normal' | 'empty' | 'missing' | 'forbidden';
	count: number;
}
export function delay(signal: AbortSignal, milliseconds = 100): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		if (signal.aborted) {
			reject(new DOMException('读取已取消', 'AbortError'));
			return;
		}
		const abort = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(new DOMException('读取已取消', 'AbortError'));
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			resolve();
		}, milliseconds);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
	});
}
export const dictionary = [
	{ value: 0, label: '待核对', raw: {} },
	{ value: '0', label: '已登记', raw: {} },
	{ value: 'active', label: '进行中', raw: {} },
	{ value: 'done', label: '已完成', raw: {} }
] as const;
export function syntheticRows(count = 100): RecordRow[] {
	return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
		id: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? '0' : `record-${index + 1}`,
		title: `${['设备巡检', '物料核对', '质量复核', '计划确认'][index % 4]} · ${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
		owner: ['陈知远', '林书宁', '周予安', '许明川'][index % 4]!,
		organization: ['研发协作中心', '东区设备保障组', '质量与交付中心'][index % 3]!,
		state: [0, '0', 'active', 'done', 'unmapped'][index % 5]!,
		created: `2026-10-${String((index % 18) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
	}));
}
export function createSyntheticServices(
	state: SyntheticState,
	audit: { endpoint: string; id?: RecordId; identity: ReadIdentity; requestId: number }[] = []
): DetailServices {
	async function start(
		endpoint: string,
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		who: ReadIdentity,
		id?: RecordId
	) {
		audit.push({ endpoint, id, identity: { ...who }, requestId: context.requestId });
		await delay(context.signal);
	}
	function find(id: RecordId) {
		return syntheticRows(state.count).find((row) => idKey(row.id) === idKey(id));
	}
	return {
		async dictionary(context, who) {
			await start('dictionary', context, who);
			if (state.failDictionary) throw Error('合成状态字典读取失败');
			return dictionary;
		},
		async list(request: AsamListRequest, context, who) {
			await start('list', context, who);
			if (state.failList) throw Error('合成列表暂不可读，请重试');
			if (state.mode === 'forbidden') throw Error('当前合成范围无读取权限');
			let rows = state.mode === 'empty' ? [] : syntheticRows(state.count);
			const query = request.query;
			if (typeof query.text === 'string' && query.text.trim())
				rows = rows.filter((row) => row.title.includes(query.text!.toString().trim()));
			if (query.state !== null && query.state !== undefined && query.state !== '')
				rows = rows.filter((row) => row.state === query.state);
			if (typeof query.owner === 'string' && query.owner.trim())
				rows = rows.filter((row) => row.owner.includes(query.owner!.toString().trim()));
			const range = query.dates;
			if (range && typeof range === 'object') {
				const start = Reflect.get(range, 'start'),
					end = Reflect.get(range, 'end');
				rows = rows.filter(
					(row) => (!start || row.created >= start) && (!end || row.created <= end)
				);
			}
			if (request.sort) {
				const { field, order } = request.sort;
				if (!['title', 'created', 'owner', 'organization', 'state', 'id'].includes(field))
					throw Error('未登记的排序字段');
				rows.sort(
					(a, b) =>
						String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
							String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
							'zh-CN'
						) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1)
				);
			}
			const offset = (request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize;
			return { list: rows.slice(offset, offset + request.pageSize), total: rows.length };
		},
		async detail(id, context, who) {
			await start('detail', context, who, id);
			if (state.failDetail) throw Error('合成详情读取失败；旧详情已清除');
			if (state.mode === 'forbidden')
				return { status: 'forbidden', message: '当前身份无权查看合成记录' };
			const row = find(id);
			if (!row || state.mode === 'missing' || state.mode === 'empty')
				return { status: 'missing', message: '合成记录不存在' };
			const data: AsamFieldModel = {
				...row,
				identifier: idKey(id),
				quantity: 0,
				priority: '普通',
				due: '2026-10-30',
				resource: { id: 0, name: '待解析附件' },
				note: '仅合成读取展示，无业务写入。',
				updated: '2026-10-18'
			};
			return { status: 'ready', data };
		},
		async flow(id, context, who) {
			await start('flow', context, who, id);
			if (state.failFlow) throw Error('流程记录读取失败，请重试');
			if (state.mode === 'forbidden') throw Error('无权查看流程记录');
			if (!find(id) || state.mode === 'missing') throw Error('流程目标不存在');
			return {
				stage: '质量复核',
				steps: [
					{ id: 'registered', name: '登记', state: 'done' },
					{ id: 'assigned', name: '分配', state: 'done' },
					{ id: 'checked', name: '现场核对', state: 'done' },
					{ id: 'review', name: '质量复核', state: 'current' },
					{ id: 'closed', name: '归档', state: 'waiting' }
				],
				records: Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) => ({
					id: `event-${index + 1}`,
					actor: ['陈知远', '林书宁', '周予安', '许明川'][index % 4]!,
					at:
						index === 3
							? null
							: `2026-10-${String(index + 10).padStart(2, '0')}T08:30:00Z`,
					result: [
						'完成合成记录登记',
						'读取分配信息',
						'补充现场核对说明',
						'原始时间缺失',
						'确认附件记录',
						'汇总核对结果',
						'进入质量复核',
						'等待后续归档'
					][index]!,
					state: index === 3 ? 'source-unknown' : 'recorded'
				})),
				related: [
					{
						id: 'relation-guide',
						title: '核对说明',
						note: '关联信息为本应用合成文本，不跳转真实业务。'
					},
					{ id: 'relation-file', title: '巡检记录.pdf', note: `关联目标 ${idKey(id)}` }
				]
			};
		},
		async resolve(ids, signal) {
			await delay(signal);
			if (state.failResource) throw Error('合成附件名称读取失败');
			return ids.map((id) => ({ id, name: `巡检记录-${idKey(id)}.pdf` }));
		}
	};
}
css
:root {
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);
	font-synthesis: none;
}
* {

}
body {

.details-demo,

	--page-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #243044);
	--page-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular);

}

	margin-right: auto;

}

}
.demo-navigation a {

}

}
label {

	align-items: center;

}
select:not([class*='el-']) {

}
.detail-template {

.access-reason {

}

}

}

.family-tech .eyebrow,
.family-tech time {

}
.family-tech .field-groups dl {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.family-tech .field-value {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 20px;
	padding: 12px 0;

}
.field-groups section {
	padding: 24px 0;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--page-line);
}
.field-groups dl {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

	margin-bottom: 0;
}
.field-groups dt {
	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--page-muted);

}

	margin: 0;
	color: var(--page-text);

}
.supplement {
	margin-top: 28px;
}
.detail-region {
	min-width: 0;
}
.flow-information {
	border-top: 1px solid var(--page-line);
	padding-top: 24px;
}
.flow-information [role='tablist'] {
	display: flex;
	gap: 4px;
	margin-bottom: 26px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--page-line);
}
.flow-information [role='tab'] {
	padding: 12px 18px;
	color: var(--page-muted);
	border: 0;
	border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
	background: transparent;
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
}
.flow-information [aria-selected='true'] {
	border-bottom-color: var(--page-accent);

}
.flow-steps {
	display: flex;
	list-style: none;
	padding: 0;
	gap: 16px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.flow-steps li {
	flex: 1 1 110px;
	border-top: 3px solid var(--page-line);

}

}

	display: block;

	color: var(--page-muted);
}
.flow-records {
	padding-left: 20px;
}

	padding: 12px 0 20px 14px;
	border-left: 1px solid var(--page-line);
}
.flow-records li > div {
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.flow-records time,
.flow-records small {
	color: var(--page-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.flow-records p {
	margin: 6px 0;
}
.related-items {

}
.demo-controls {
	margin: 24px auto;

	max-width: 1500px;
	font-size: 13px;

.demo-controls button:not([class*='el-']) {

}
.detail-template :is(input:not([class*='el-']), textarea:not([class*='el-']), select) {
	color-scheme: inherit;
}
/* Date and time controls draw focus on their visible wrapper. */
.details-demo
	:is(
		button:not([class*='el-']),
		a,
		input:not([class*='el-']),
		select:not([class*='el-']),
		textarea:not([class*='el-']),
		[tabindex]
	):focus-visible:not(:where(.asam-date-time-control .el-input__wrapper > input)) {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.page-heading {
		animation: details-arrive 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	.flow-information [role='tab'] {
		transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	@keyframes details-arrive {
		from {
			transform: translateY(5px);
			opacity: 0.85;
		}
		to {
			transform: none;
			opacity: 1;
		}
	}
}
@media (max-width: 1000px) {
	.document-layout,
	.console-layout {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.context-rail {
		border-top: 1px solid var(--page-line);
		padding-top: 24px;
	}
	.family-tech .context-rail {
		border-left: 0;
		padding-left: 0;
	}
	.brand-layout {
		grid-template-columns: 190px minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.demo-navigation {
		padding: 16px;
		gap: 12px;
	}
	.wordmark {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.detail-template {
		padding: 24px 16px;
	}
	.page-heading {
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: 12px;
	}
	.brand-layout {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.family-brand {
		padding: 0;
	}
	.family-brand .context-rail {
		padding: 24px 20px;
	}
	.family-brand .context-rail h2 {
		max-width: none;
		font-size: 24px;
		margin: 12px 0;
	}
	.family-brand .context-rail dl {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 12px 20px;
	}
	.family-brand .rail-foot {
		margin: 0;
	}
	.family-brand .field-groups section {
		display: block;
	}
	.field-groups dl {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.family-tech {
		border-width: 5px;
	}

	.family-tech .field-value {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		gap: 4px;
	}
	.demo-controls {
		padding: 16px;
	}
	.flow-information [role='tab'] {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.detail-template .asam-pro-detail-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
}

/* Authored template actions keep translated labels reachable at narrow widths. */
.template-message-button.el-button {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	min-height: var(--el-component-size, 32px);
	margin-inline: 0;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.template-message-button.el-button > span {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	display: block;
}
ts
import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import type { Router } from 'vue-router';
import type { AsamDataRuntime, AsamPage, AsamRequestContext, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDetailResult, AsamListIntent, AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

export type RecordId = string | number;
export type Family = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type PageKind = 'list' | 'detail' | 'flow';
export type FlowTab = 'overview' | 'history' | 'related';
export interface RecordRow {
	readonly id: RecordId;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly owner: string;
	readonly organization: string;
	readonly state: string | number;
	readonly created: string;
}
export interface ReadIdentity {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly revision: number;
}
export interface FlowStep {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly state: 'done' | 'current' | 'waiting' | 'unknown';

import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { gate } from './Protocol.js';
const app = useApplication();
const techTheme = { colorMode: 'dark' };
const faults = inject(syntheticStateKey);
const families = [
	{
		id: 'minimal',
		get label() {
			return i18n.t('app.templates.details.minimalStyle');

	},
	{

function guardLink(event, navigate) {
	if (!gate(app, 'switch-family')) event.preventDefault();
	else void navigate(event);
}
function changeIdentity() {
	app.access.identity = app.access.identity === 'reader-a' ? 'reader-b' : 'reader-a';
}
function changeScope() {
	app.access.scope = app.access.scope === 'synthetic-east' ? 'synthetic-west' : 'synthetic-east';
	app.runtime.setScope(app.access.scope);
}
function replaceServices() {
	app.services = markRaw(createSyntheticServices(faults));
}
function updateAppSize(value) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		app.size = value;
}
function updateFaultsMode(value) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'empty' || value === 'missing' || value === 'forbidden')
		faults.mode = value;
}

import { createApp, markRaw, reactive, shallowReactive } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHashHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { getAsamDataRuntime, provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { detailApplicationKey } from './Types.js';
import { createSyntheticServices } from './Service.js';
import App from './App.vue';
import MinimalList from './minimal/ListPage.vue';
import MinimalDetail from './minimal/DetailPage.vue';
import MinimalFlow from './minimal/FlowPage.vue';
import BrandList from './brand/ListPage.vue';
import BrandDetail from './brand/DetailPage.vue';
import BrandFlow from './brand/FlowPage.vue';
import TechList from './tech/ListPage.vue';
import TechDetail from './tech/DetailPage.vue';
import TechFlow from './tech/FlowPage.vue';
export const syntheticStateKey = Symbol('synthetic state');
export function mountDetailApplication(element, i18n, onError) {
	const app = createApp(App);
	if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	const faults = reactive({
		failList: false,
		failDetail: false,
		failFlow: false,
		failDictionary: false,
		failResource: false,
		mode: 'normal',
		count: 100
	});
	const audit = [];
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHashHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', redirect: '/minimal/list' },
			...[
				['minimal', MinimalList, MinimalDetail, MinimalFlow],
				['brand', BrandList, BrandDetail, BrandFlow],
				['tech', TechList, TechDetail, TechFlow]
			].flatMap(([family, list, detail, flow]) => [
				{ path: `/${family}/list`, component: list },
				{ path: `/${family}/detail/:type/:id`, component: detail },
				{ path: `/${family}/flow/:type/:id`, component: flow }
			]),
			{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', redirect: '/minimal/list' }
		]
	});
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'synthetic-east' });
	const context = shallowReactive({
		runtime: markRaw(getAsamDataRuntime(app)),
		router: markRaw(router),
		access: reactive({
			identity: 'reader-a',
			scope: 'synthetic-east',
			revision: 1,
			disabled: false,
			readonly: false,
			allowed: true
		}),
		services: markRaw(createSyntheticServices(faults, audit)),
		returnState: null,
		size: 'default',
		dark: matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
	});
	app.provide(detailApplicationKey, context);
	app.provide(syntheticStateKey, faults);
	app.use(router);
	((app.config.errorHandler = onError), app.mount(element));
	return { app, context, faults, audit, router };
}

import { defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamFieldModes,
	createAsamNumberField,
	createAsamTemporalField,
	createAsamResourceField,
	createAsamResourceDisplayReader
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { gate, identity } from './Protocol.js';
export const templateConfig = {
	pageSize: 20,
	groups: ['事项摘要', '责任与安排', '资料与备注']
};
export const initialQuery = () => ({
	text: '',
	state: null,
	dates: { start: null, end: null },
	owner: ''
});
export function createPageFields(app) {
	const source = defineAsamOptions().api({
		api: async (_params, context) => {
			if (!gate(app, 'dictionary-read') || !app.runtime.isCurrent(context))
				throw Error('字典读取门禁已变更');
			return app.services.dictionary(context, identity(app));
		},
		params: {},
		transform: (items) => items,
		fieldNames: { value: 'value', label: 'label' }
	});
	const query = [
		{ key: 'text', label: '事项名称', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'state', label: '状态', kind: 'single', source },
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'dates',
			label: '登记日期区间',
			kind: 'date',
			range: true,
			allowOpen: true
		}),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', kind: 'text' }
	];
	const groups = templateConfig.groups;
	const grouping = (group) => ({ detail: { layout: { group } } });
	const fields = [
		{ key: 'title', label: '事项名称', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[0]) },
		{
			key: 'identifier',
			label: '稳定标识（类型:值）',
			kind: 'text',
			modes: grouping(groups[0])
		},
		{ key: 'state', label: '状态', kind: 'single', source, modes: grouping(groups[0]) },
		createAsamNumberField({
			key: 'quantity',
			label: '待核对数量',
			integer: true,
			min: 0,
			modes: grouping(groups[0])
		}),
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[1]) },
		{ key: 'organization', label: '组织', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[1]) },
		{ key: 'priority', label: '优先级', kind: 'text', modes: grouping(groups[1]) },
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'due',
			label: '计划日期',
			kind: 'date',
			modes: grouping(groups[1])
		}),
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'created',
			label: '登记日期',
			kind: 'date',
			modes: grouping(groups[2])
		}),
		createAsamTemporalField({
			key: 'updated',
			label: '更新日期',
			kind: 'date',
			modes: grouping(groups[2])
		}),
		createAsamResourceField({
			key: 'resource',
			label: '关联附件',
			modes: grouping(groups[2]),
			services: {
				upload: async () => {
					throw Error('本模板不提供上传');
				}
			}
		}),
		{ key: 'note', label: '备注', kind: 'textarea', modes: grouping(groups[2]) }
	];
	const bindings = fields.map((field) => ({
		field,
		...(field.key === 'resource'
			? {
					reader: createAsamResourceDisplayReader(async (ids, signal) => {
						if (!gate(app, 'resource-read')) throw Error('附件读取门禁已变更');
						return app.services.resolve(ids, signal);
					})
				}
			: {})
	}));
	const modes = createAsamFieldModes({ bindings });

const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
import { computed, useId } from 'vue';

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { cloneAsamFieldValue } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
export const families = ['minimal', 'brand', 'tech'];
export function parseId(type, value) {
	if (
		type === 'number' &&
		typeof value === 'string' &&
		value.trim() !== '' &&
		Number.isFinite(Number(value))

		return Number(value);
	if (type === 'string' && typeof value === 'string' && value !== '') return value;
	throw createAsamMessageError(
		new TypeError('记录 ID 必须是非空字符串或有限数字；拒绝 boolean/null'),
		'app.templates.details.recordIdMustBeANonemptyStringOrFinite'
	);
}
export function idKey(id) {
	if (!((typeof id === 'string' && id !== '') || (typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id))))
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('无效记录 ID'),
			'app.templates.details.invalidRecordId'
		);

}
export function listTarget(family) {
	return `/${family}/list`;
}
export function safeReturn(value, family) {
	return typeof value === 'string' && families.some((item) => value === listTarget(item))
		? value

}

	return {
		identity: app.access.identity,
		scope: app.access.scope,
		revision: app.access.revision

}

	return app.access.allowed && !app.access.disabled && app.runtime.scope === app.access.scope;
}
export function gate(app, action) {
	if (!readable(app)) return false;
	const snapshot = identity(app),
		epoch = app.runtime.epoch,
		services = app.services;
	app.beforeAction?.(action);
	return (
		readable(app) &&
		services === app.services &&
		epoch === app.runtime.epoch &&
		snapshot.identity === app.access.identity &&
		snapshot.scope === app.access.scope &&
		snapshot.revision === app.access.revision

}

}

	if (saved.intent.sort && (await controller.setSort(saved.intent.sort)).status !== 'success')
		return;
	if (!current()) return;
	const last = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(controller.page.data.value.total / saved.intent.pageSize));
	await controller.setPage(Math.min(saved.intent.currentPage, last));
}

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamCrudPage } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import { AsamFieldView } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useListPage } from './Pages.js';
import { idKey } from './Protocol.js';
const props = defineProps({
	family: { type: String, required: true }
});
const { app, crud, session, stateBinding, reason, open, i18n } = useListPage(props.family);
const rowActions = computed(() => {
	const list = crud.value?.list;
	return [
		{
			id: 'basic-details',
			label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.basicDetails'),
			run: async ({ row }) => {
				if (row && list) await open(row, 'detail', list);
			}
		},
		{
			id: 'flow-details',
			label: i18n.t('app.templates.details.flowDetails'),
			run: async ({ row }) => {
				if (row && list) await open(row, 'flow', list);
			}
		}
	];
});
</script>

import { idKey } from './Protocol.js';
export function delay(signal, milliseconds = 100) {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		if (signal.aborted) {
			reject(new DOMException('读取已取消', 'AbortError'));
			return;
		}
		const abort = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(new DOMException('读取已取消', 'AbortError'));
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			resolve();
		}, milliseconds);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
	});
}
export const dictionary = [
	{ value: 0, label: '待核对', raw: {} },
	{ value: '0', label: '已登记', raw: {} },
	{ value: 'active', label: '进行中', raw: {} },
	{ value: 'done', label: '已完成', raw: {} }
];
export function syntheticRows(count = 100) {
	return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
		id: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? '0' : `record-${index + 1}`,
		title: `${['设备巡检', '物料核对', '质量复核', '计划确认'][index % 4]} · ${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
		owner: ['陈知远', '林书宁', '周予安', '许明川'][index % 4],
		organization: ['研发协作中心', '东区设备保障组', '质量与交付中心'][index % 3],
		state: [0, '0', 'active', 'done', 'unmapped'][index % 5],
		created: `2026-10-${String((index % 18) + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`
	}));
}
export function createSyntheticServices(state, audit = []) {
	async function start(endpoint, context, who, id) {
		audit.push({ endpoint, id, identity: { ...who }, requestId: context.requestId });
		await delay(context.signal);
	}
	function find(id) {
		return syntheticRows(state.count).find((row) => idKey(row.id) === idKey(id));
	}
	return {
		async dictionary(context, who) {
			await start('dictionary', context, who);
			if (state.failDictionary) throw Error('合成状态字典读取失败');
			return dictionary;
		},
		async list(request, context, who) {
			await start('list', context, who);
			if (state.failList) throw Error('合成列表暂不可读，请重试');
			if (state.mode === 'forbidden') throw Error('当前合成范围无读取权限');
			let rows = state.mode === 'empty' ? [] : syntheticRows(state.count);
			const query = request.query;
			if (typeof query.text === 'string' && query.text.trim())
				rows = rows.filter((row) => row.title.includes(query.text.toString().trim()));
			if (query.state !== null && query.state !== undefined && query.state !== '')
				rows = rows.filter((row) => row.state === query.state);
			if (typeof query.owner === 'string' && query.owner.trim())
				rows = rows.filter((row) => row.owner.includes(query.owner.toString().trim()));
			const range = query.dates;
			if (range && typeof range === 'object') {
				const start = Reflect.get(range, 'start'),
					end = Reflect.get(range, 'end');
				rows = rows.filter(
					(row) => (!start || row.created >= start) && (!end || row.created <= end)
				);
			}
			if (request.sort) {
				const { field, order } = request.sort;
				if (!['title', 'created', 'owner', 'organization', 'state', 'id'].includes(field))
					throw Error('未登记的排序字段');
				rows.sort(
					(a, b) =>
						String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
							String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
							'zh-CN'
						) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1)
				);
			}
			const offset = (request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize;
			return { list: rows.slice(offset, offset + request.pageSize), total: rows.length };
		},
		async detail(id, context, who) {
			await start('detail', context, who, id);
			if (state.failDetail) throw Error('合成详情读取失败；旧详情已清除');
			if (state.mode === 'forbidden')
				return { status: 'forbidden', message: '当前身份无权查看合成记录' };
			const row = find(id);
			if (!row || state.mode === 'missing' || state.mode === 'empty')
				return { status: 'missing', message: '合成记录不存在' };
			const data = {
				...row,
				identifier: idKey(id),
				quantity: 0,
				priority: '普通',
				due: '2026-10-30',
				resource: { id: 0, name: '待解析附件' },
				note: '仅合成读取展示，无业务写入。',
				updated: '2026-10-18'
			};
			return { status: 'ready', data };
		},
		async flow(id, context, who) {
			await start('flow', context, who, id);
			if (state.failFlow) throw Error('流程记录读取失败，请重试');
			if (state.mode === 'forbidden') throw Error('无权查看流程记录');
			if (!find(id) || state.mode === 'missing') throw Error('流程目标不存在');
			return {
				stage: '质量复核',
				steps: [
					{ id: 'registered', name: '登记', state: 'done' },
					{ id: 'assigned', name: '分配', state: 'done' },
					{ id: 'checked', name: '现场核对', state: 'done' },
					{ id: 'review', name: '质量复核', state: 'current' },
					{ id: 'closed', name: '归档', state: 'waiting' }
				],
				records: Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) => ({
					id: `event-${index + 1}`,
					actor: ['陈知远', '林书宁', '周予安', '许明川'][index % 4],
					at:
						index === 3
							? null
							: `2026-10-${String(index + 10).padStart(2, '0')}T08:30:00Z`,
					result: [
						'完成合成记录登记',
						'读取分配信息',
						'补充现场核对说明',
						'原始时间缺失',
						'确认附件记录',
						'汇总核对结果',
						'进入质量复核',
						'等待后续归档'
					][index],
					state: index === 3 ? 'source-unknown' : 'recorded'
				})),
				related: [
					{
						id: 'relation-guide',
						title: '核对说明',
						note: '关联信息为本应用合成文本，不跳转真实业务。'
					},
					{ id: 'relation-file', title: '巡检记录.pdf', note: `关联目标 ${idKey(id)}` }
				]
			};
		},
		async resolve(ids, signal) {
			await delay(signal);
			if (state.failResource) throw Error('合成附件名称读取失败');
			return ids.map((id) => ({ id, name: `巡检记录-${idKey(id)}.pdf` }));
		}
	};
}

:root {
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif);
	font-synthesis: none;
}
* {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.details-demo,
.detail-template {
	--page-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f6f7f9);
	--page-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--page-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #243044);
	--page-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	--page-line: var(--asam-color-border);
	--page-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);

	color: var(--page-text);
}

	gap: 12px 20px;
	padding: 16px 32px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--page-line);
	background: var(--page-surface);
}
.wordmark {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.09em;
	font-weight: 700;
}
.wordmark b {
	font-weight: 400;
	color: var(--page-muted);
}
.demo-navigation a {
	color: var(--page-text);
	text-decoration: none;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.demo-navigation a.router-link-active {
	color: var(--page-accent);
	text-decoration: underline;
	text-underline-offset: 6px;
}
label {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 6px;
}
select:not([class*='el-']) {
	max-width: 100%;
	color: var(--page-text);
	background: var(--page-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--page-line);
	padding: 5px;
}
.detail-template {
	padding: 40px;
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	min-width: 0;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	background: var(--page-surface);
}
.detail-template :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, p, dl) {
	margin-top: 0;
}
.detail-template h1 {
	font-size: clamp(26px, 3vw, 36px);
	line-height: 1.25;
	letter-spacing: -0.025em;
	margin-bottom: 14px;
}

	font-size: 20px;
	line-height: 1.45;
}

	font-size: 17px;
}

	font-size: 15px;
}
.detail-template p {

}
.page-heading {
	display: flex;

	align-items: flex-start;

}
.page-heading > div {

.document-layout {

}

}

}

}

}

}
.family-minimal {

}
.access-reason {
	font-size: 13px;

.records-list .el-table {

}
.console-layout {

	gap: 32px;
}

	border-left: 1px solid var(--page-line);
	padding-left: 26px;
}

.family-tech .eyebrow,
.family-tech time {
	font-family: monospace;
}
.family-tech .field-groups dl {
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}
.family-tech .field-value {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 160px minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 20px;
	padding: 12px 0;

}
.field-groups section {
	padding: 24px 0;
	border-top: 1px solid var(--page-line);
}

	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

	margin-bottom: 0;
}
.field-groups dt {

}

	margin: 0;
	color: var(--page-text);
	min-width: 0;
}
.supplement {
	margin-top: 28px;
}
.detail-region {
	min-width: 0;
}
.flow-information {
	border-top: 1px solid var(--page-line);
	padding-top: 24px;
}
.flow-information [role='tablist'] {
	display: flex;
	gap: 4px;
	margin-bottom: 26px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--page-line);
}
.flow-information [role='tab'] {
	padding: 12px 18px;
	color: var(--page-muted);
	border: 0;
	border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
	background: transparent;
	font: inherit;
	cursor: pointer;
}
.flow-information [aria-selected='true'] {
	border-bottom-color: var(--page-accent);
	color: var(--page-text);
}
.flow-steps {
	display: flex;
	list-style: none;
	padding: 0;
	gap: 16px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.flow-steps li {
	flex: 1 1 110px;
	border-top: 3px solid var(--page-line);
	padding-top: 12px;
}

	border-color: var(--page-accent);
}
.flow-steps strong {
	display: block;
	font-size: 12px;
	color: var(--page-muted);
}
.flow-records {
	padding-left: 20px;
}
.flow-records li {
	padding: 12px 0 20px 14px;
	border-left: 1px solid var(--page-line);
}
.flow-records li > div {
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.flow-records time,
.flow-records small {
	color: var(--page-muted);
	font-size: 12px;
}
.flow-records p {
	margin: 6px 0;
}
.related-items {
	padding-left: 20px;
}
.demo-controls {
	margin: 24px auto;
	padding: 20px 32px;
	max-width: 1500px;
	font-size: 13px;
}
.demo-controls label {
	margin: 12px;
}
.demo-controls button:not([class*='el-']) {
	margin: 8px;
}
.detail-template button:not([class*='el-']),
.demo-controls button:not([class*='el-']) {
	font-family: inherit;
}
.detail-template :is(input:not([class*='el-']), textarea:not([class*='el-']), select) {
	color-scheme: inherit;
}
/* Date and time controls draw focus on their visible wrapper. */
.details-demo
	:is(
		button:not([class*='el-']),
		a,
		input:not([class*='el-']),
		select:not([class*='el-']),
		textarea:not([class*='el-']),
		[tabindex]
	):focus-visible:not(:where(.asam-date-time-control .el-input__wrapper > input)) {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.page-heading {
		animation: details-arrive 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	.flow-information [role='tab'] {
		transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	@keyframes details-arrive {
		from {
			transform: translateY(5px);
			opacity: 0.85;
		}
		to {
			transform: none;
			opacity: 1;
		}
	}
}
@media (max-width: 1000px) {

	.console-layout {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);

	.context-rail {
		border-top: 1px solid var(--page-line);

	.brand-layout {
		grid-template-columns: 190px minmax(0, 1fr);

}
@media (max-width: 767px) {

		gap: 12px;

	.detail-template {

	.page-heading {

	}
	.brand-layout {

	}
	.family-brand {

	}

	}

	}
	.family-brand .context-rail dl {

		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 12px 20px;
	}
	.family-brand .rail-foot {
		margin: 0;
	}
	.family-brand .field-groups section {
		display: block;
	}
	.field-groups dl {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.family-tech {
		border-width: 5px;
	}

	.family-tech .field-value {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
		gap: 4px;
	}
	.demo-controls {
		padding: 16px;
	}
	.flow-information [role='tab'] {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.detail-template .asam-pro-detail-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
}

/* Authored template actions keep translated labels reachable at narrow widths. */
.template-message-button.el-button {
	min-width: 0;
	max-width: 100%;
	height: auto;
	min-height: var(--el-component-size, 32px);
	margin-inline: 0;
	padding-block: var(--asam-space-xs, 4px);
	white-space: normal;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.template-message-button.el-button > span {
	min-width: 0;

import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { messages as en } from './en.js';
import { messages as zhCn } from './zh-CN.js';
export const templateMessages = Object.freeze({ en, 'zh-CN': zhCn });
export const useTemplateI18n = () => useAsamProI18n(templateMessages);
export function templateText(scope, key) {
	return scope.t(...[key]);
}

筛选协作记录，查看基础信息或跟踪处理流程。

使用与 API

本目录通过完整应用源码接入，按下方接口与行为说明提供宿主依赖。

完整示例

独立挂载入口：website-hosts/details.ts。复制全部依赖文件，按接入说明加载三份公共样式后，调用该入口导出的 await mountWebsiteExample(element, onError)，并在页面销毁时调用返回的释放函数。这个入口保留原示例的 router、provider 和上下文注入，不能只复制 App.vue。

接口、行为与迁移细节

接口与行为

本目录是可复制页面源码；没有新增库根出口。公开类型在 Types.ts，合成数据协议在 Service.ts，配置在 Config.ts。

入口 输入/输出 责任
mountDetailApplication DOM选择器/Element → app/context/faults/audit/router 创建独立演示应用和实例内内存状态
detailApplicationKey DetailApplication注入 页面共享宿主依赖；同应用的runtime必须与字段视图提供者一致
DetailServices.list AsamListRequest/context/ReadIdentity → AsamPage 查询、唯一分页和排序的合成读取
DetailServices.detail string或number ID/context/ReadIdentity → AsamDetailResult ready/missing/forbidden，异常走编辑与详情协议错误状态
DetailServices.flow 同上 → FlowData 服务明确步骤/记录/关联内容，状态顺序不由客户端猜测
DetailServices.dictionary context/ReadIdentity → typed value/label数组 通过原Options协议读取，失败可刷新
DetailServices.resolve typed资源ID数组/AbortSignal → 元数据数组 只读名称解析，绝不上传/删除
beforeAction 同步action回调 允许重入；身份/范围/修订/服务/epoch/权限变化后本动作停止
useListPage Family及可选借入ListController → 页面绑定 自有effectScope按语义会话释放；借入控制器不dispose
useDetailPage Family/是否流程/可选借入DetailController → 页面绑定 open/refresh/返回和独立流程读取；借入控制器由宿主维护目标
safeReturn unknown/Family → 注册本地列表路径 拒绝外URL与未登记路径
parseId/idKey 路由type/value及typed ID 保留0和string0，拒绝boolean/null/空串/非有限数字

路由：/{minimal|brand|tech}/list、/{family}/detail/{number|string}/{id}、/{family}/flow/{number|string}/{id}，使用实际 Vue Router hash history。 记录ID经过路由编码；returnTo是严格注册列表路径，额外内容不接受。可复制到宿主注册的route records，不复用真实业务URL。

PageAccess 的 identity/scope/revision、services引用和runtime epoch共同隔离读取。scope须与runtime.scope一致；宿主更换scope时调用runtime.setScope。 可选借入控制器只绑定初始明确会话；任一上述边界/目标/禁用权限状态变化后，模板隔离旧视图且不操作借入资源，宿主须以新key和当前目标的明确新会话重建页面。九个正式页面均自行创建控制器，自动重建与恢复不依赖此借入适配选项。 相同身份值的computed重算不构成新会话；readonly变化不会打断在途读，disabled/allowed变化会停本页请求和视图。 所有新服务调用和导航在同步宿主回调后再次核门禁。旧resolve/reject只能完成旧Promise，不得写入当前目标。 运行时属于宿主，页面只release自己创建的context；列表控制器的销毁遵循列表控制器的effect scope，详情遵循编辑与详情协议的dispose。

FlowSections 接受 data/loading/error/tab/disabled，发出 select(tab)、retry()，不包含审批或编辑事件。 页签键盘支持左右/Home/End，当前页签是Tab停留点，Enter/Space沿原生button。 非法页签回退概览；切换目标/identity/scope/revision/services/epoch后恢复概览。首次全部内容读取，切页签不另发服务请求。

四尺寸为 large=40、big=36、default=32、small=28，由正常ApplicationProvider继承。 业务ID类型若变更，先在宿主显式迁移，不能String化所有ID；DTO/日期/资源模型迁移遵循字段模式与转换公开模式，不重复转换。 通过复制完整模板接入，不要求修改已有组件包接口。

使用说明

九个完整可编辑页面覆盖列表入口、详情和流程详情，并提供简约、品牌与科技布局。

风格 查询列表 基础详情 流程详情
克制简约 minimal/ListPage.vue minimal/DetailPage.vue minimal/FlowPage.vue
品牌分栏 brand/ListPage.vue brand/DetailPage.vue brand/FlowPage.vue
深色科技 tech/ListPage.vue tech/DetailPage.vue tech/FlowPage.vue

复制本目录到自己的 Vue 应用，用同版正常 @asam-ui/ui、@asam-ui/pro、Vue 3.5.34、Element Plus 2.14.7 和 Vue Router 4.6.3。 从 Application.ts 导入 mountDetailApplication，调用 mountDetailApplication('#app')。 应用入口同时导入 Element Plus 的基础样式和两个 ASAM 正常包的 style.css。 这是完整独立演示应用；现有宿主接入请按 API 只注入自己的 router/runtime/services。

复制完整目录到独立 Vue 工程，安装配对的普通包与精确依赖，并保留有效锁。执行类型检查、构建，再观察真实页面；不使用指向组件库源码的别名。

默认列表有100条合成记录、20条/页、六个数据列、四个查询字段，表格的选择/操作列为额外辅助列。 三个风格都用 AsamCrudPage 的 query-table 模式渲染查询、表格、分页和行操作。 useAsamReadonlyCrudController 接入既有列表会话，查询、分页、排序、错误恢复及列表返回共享同一成功来源。 0、'0' 分别为数字与字符串记录身份；false、null、空串不是合法记录 ID。 状态字典保留类型和值，未解析值显示原文与明确提示，不把标签写回 ID。 日期是 YYYY-MM-DD 日历日期，区间含首尾、允许单端；空条件由原字段转换省略。流程时间为明确 UTC ISO 字符串，缺失时间不推断。

基础详情使用编辑与详情协议的 useAsamDetail/AsamDetailPanel 管理会话和状态，通过字段模式与转换的 createAsamFieldModes、AsamFieldView 和资源 display reader 展示12字段/3组。 Panel 的公开 slot 承载字段模式视图，传入仅将 fields 投影为空的同一控制器视图，避免旧字段渲染器再输出一份字段；控制器仍按完整字段克隆/初始化。 数值、日期、状态、资源均走公开模型。刷新会先清旧数据；失败显示错误，再刷新可恢复。 流程详情额外读取独立 flow 端点，首次加载完整三页签、五步骤、八记录；不是隐藏未加载内容的懒加载。

列表进入详情前只保存 successfulSource 的类型化已提交意图。返回通过公开 replaceConditions/pageSize/sort/page 方法恢复，用户新草稿或范围变化会终止旧恢复。 状态仅在本应用内存中存在。刷新浏览器或直接打开详情后，返回当前风格的默认本地列表。 returnTo 只接受注册的三个列表路径，外部URL、未知路径、额外query/hash均回退，不依赖导航模板路由能力。

合成服务只延迟100ms读取本地内存数据。没有真实后端、CL、账号、云存储或流程写入。 示例底部可切换错误/缺失/无权、只读/禁用、身份/范围/修订/服务；readonly可读返，disabled暂停读取、页签和导航。 自行创建的控制器/请求由页面释放；借入runtime不销毁，借入控制器不close/dispose，宿主负责其目标与生命周期。

布局与主题

简约族采用文档主栏和清晰分隔；品牌族突出身份与内容层次；科技族使用深底信息台。三族保留相同业务协议和公开控件。

使用 ASAM tokens 和 40/36/32/28 四尺寸。科技族保持深底，简约与品牌随父主题适配。轻入场 180ms 不阻塞操作，减少动态时停用；窄屏单列、表格局部横滚、长字段换行。

完整类型

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import type { Router } from 'vue-router';
import type { AsamDataRuntime, AsamPage, AsamRequestContext, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDetailResult, AsamListIntent, AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro';

export type RecordId = string | number;
export type Family = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export type PageKind = 'list' | 'detail' | 'flow';
export type FlowTab = 'overview' | 'history' | 'related';
export interface RecordRow {
	readonly id: RecordId;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly owner: string;
	readonly organization: string;
	readonly state: string | number;
	readonly created: string;
}
export interface ReadIdentity {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly revision: number;
}
export interface FlowStep {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly state: 'done' | 'current' | 'waiting' | 'unknown';
}
export interface FlowRecord {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly actor: string;
	readonly at: string | null;
	readonly result: string;
	readonly state: string;
}
export interface FlowData {
	readonly stage: string;
	readonly steps: readonly FlowStep[];
	readonly records: readonly FlowRecord[];
	readonly related: readonly {
		readonly id: string;
		readonly title: string;
		readonly note: string;
	}[];
}
export interface DetailServices {
	dictionary(
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		identity: ReadIdentity
	): Promise<readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]>;
	list(
		request: AsamListRequest,
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		identity: ReadIdentity
	): Promise<AsamPage<RecordRow>>;
	detail(
		id: RecordId,
		context: AsamRequestContext,
		identity: ReadIdentity
	): Promise<AsamDetailResult>;
	flow(id: RecordId, context: AsamRequestContext, identity: ReadIdentity): Promise<FlowData>;
	resolve(
		ids: readonly RecordId[],
		signal: AbortSignal
	): Promise<readonly { id: RecordId; name: string }[]>;
}
export interface PageAccess extends ReadIdentity {
	identity: string;
	scope: string;
	revision: number;
	disabled: boolean;
	readonly: boolean;
	allowed: boolean;
}
export interface ReturnState extends ReadIdentity {
	readonly epoch: number;
	readonly services: DetailServices;
	readonly target: string;
	readonly intent: AsamListIntent;
}
export interface DetailApplication {
	readonly runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly router: Router;
	readonly access: PageAccess;
	services: DetailServices;
	size: AsamControlSize;
	dark: boolean;
	returnState: ReturnState | null;
	/** 同步宿主通知，回调可能重入并修改身份/权限。回调后必须重新核门禁。 */
	beforeAction?: (action: string) => void;
}
export const detailApplicationKey: InjectionKey<DetailApplication> =
	Symbol('ASAM detail application');
